summary: Iteration 138 - BidBlitz Mobility Platform (Phase 3) Testing Complete. All backend APIs (13/13 tests PASS) and frontend features working correctly. Map renders with OpenStreetMap/Leaflet, address autocomplete via Nominatim works, route calculation shows 6 transport options with prices, wallet balance and payment methods load correctly. Minor Leaflet console error observed but does not block functionality.

issues: Minor: Leaflet console error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _leaflet_pos)' appears on page load - does not block functionality but indicates potential race condition in map initialization

backend_api_tests.search_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/search returns autocomplete results for 'Berlin Hauptbahnhof'
backend_api_tests.route_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/route returns 6 transport options with prices
backend_api_tests.nearby_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/nearby returns vehicle counts and markers
backend_api_tests.payment_options_endpoint: PASS - /api/mobility-platform/payment-options returns wallet balance and 5 payment methods

frontend_tests.login_and_navigation: PASS - Login with admin@bidblitz.com and navigation to /mobility-map works
frontend_tests.map_rendering: PASS - OpenStreetMap tiles render correctly with data-testid='mobility-platform-map'
frontend_tests.pickup_auto_fill: PASS - Pickup field auto-populated via GPS fallback (Mati 1, Matiqan, Kosovo)
frontend_tests.dropoff_autocomplete: PASS - Typing 'Berlin Hauptbahnhof' shows search results panel
frontend_tests.search_result_selection: PASS - Clicking search result sets destination
frontend_tests.price_comparison_button: PASS - 'Preise vergleichen' button triggers route calculation
frontend_tests.transport_options_display: PASS - All 6 transport types displayed (Taxi, E-Scooter, Fahrrad, Mietwagen, Airport Shuttle, VIP Chauffeur)
frontend_tests.wallet_balance_display: PASS - Wallet balance €8533.88 shown in header
frontend_tests.bottom_sheet: PASS - Bottom sheet with recommendations and options visible
frontend_tests.detail_sheet: PASS - Clicking transport option opens detail sheet with price, time, distance, payment methods
frontend_tests.recent_section: PASS - Recent section visible with saved locations

mobility_map_core.details: OpenStreetMap + Leaflet map renders, GPS targeting works, map click sets pickup/dropoff

address_autocomplete.details: Nominatim-based autocomplete returns relevant results for German addresses

route_calculation.details: OSRM routing returns distance, duration, and geometry for route display

price_comparison.details: 6 transport options with dynamic pricing based on distance/duration

payment_integration.details: Wallet balance and 5 payment methods (Wallet, NFC, QR, Apple Pay, Google Pay) displayed

action_items: MINOR: Consider fixing Leaflet map initialization to prevent '_leaflet_pos' console error - likely caused by useEffect dependencies triggering map re-creation
critical_code_review_comments: The useEffect that creates the Leaflet map (line 199-224) has many dependencies that could cause unnecessary re-renders and the observed console error
Consider using useRef for map instance and only initializing once, or using a more stable dependency array
seed_data_creation: TEST_home and TEST_recent locations created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 138 verified the new BidBlitz Mobility Platform (Phase 3) at /mobility-map. All backend APIs work correctly (search, reverse, route, nearby, payment-options, saved-locations, recent-locations).
